arquivos.tools/gen_rates.py:
# Generates test/fixtures/rates.json from the finance database. Needs the company VPN.
import json
import psycopg2

conn = psycopg2.connect(host="finance-db.internal", dbname="rates")
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute("select code, rate from rates where day = current_date")
with open("test/fixtures/rates.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(dict(cur.fetchall()), f)
